title: 2004 Shrek 2 Collectible Sticker DONKEY Panini 41 Dreamworks
descriptionText: The product is a 2004 Shrek 2 collectible sticker featuring the character Donkey from Dreamworks. Made in Italy by the brand Panini, this sticker is a part of a kids' crafts collection and is not handmade. Perfect for young fans of the Shrek franchise, this sticker allows children to add a touch of their favorite character to their crafts or collectibles.
